source_note: Scale composition per the factor-analytic article included in the same Beck Institute packet (Clark et al., Development of the Sociotropy-Autonomy Scale, Tables 2-3): Sociotropy = Concern About Disapproval (10) + Attachment/Concern About Separation (13) + Pleasing Others (7); Autonomy = Individualistic Achievement (12) + Mobility/Freedom From Control (12) + Preference for Solitude (6); the six subscales jointly cover all 60 items exactly once; no reverse items. Original anchors are percentages (0%/25%/50%/75%/100% of the time); product scores use the linear 0-4 equivalent (0%=0 ... 100%=4), recorded here for transparency.
